column2: On https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html, find the section that defines the 404 status code. Report its section number and its exact title.
On https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html, find the definition of the "Accept" header. Report the section number that defines it and explain, in one sentence, what the header does.
On https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html, find the "Cache-Control: no-store" directive and state its operating rule (what a recipient MUST NOT do when it applies).
On https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interactive-elements.html, find the description of the showModal() method for the dialog element and state the effect of calling it.
On https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AbortController, find how to cancel a fetch() request and state the mechanism used (which object/option you must pass).
On https://docs.python.org/3/reference/simple_stmts.html, find the "raise" statement's "raise ... from ..." syntax and describe its purpose in one sentence.
On https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/, state the three probe types the page documents.
On https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/indexes-types.html, list the available index types and identify the one the docs say is suitable for full-text search.
On https://docs.openssl.org/3.3/man1/openssl-enc/, explain what the -cipher option does (which algorithm the command will use).
On https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-order.html, find the criterion number for "Focus Order" and its conformance level (A, AA, or AAA).

Open https://demo.playwright.dev/todomvc and do this in order: add three todos named "alpha", "beta", "gamma" (type each name into the input and press Enter); then mark "beta" as completed by clicking its checkbox; then click the "Active" filter link. Report (a) the exact "items left" counter text and (b) which todo names are listed under the Active filter.

Open https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html, fill the "Text input" field with "Jan Kowalski" and the "Password" field with "secret1", then click the Submit button. Report the heading and the message text shown on the page you land on.
On https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_chemical_elements, report the atomic number, the chemical symbol, and the standard atomic weight of Tungsten.
On https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_airports_in_Iceland, for Keflavík Airport report its IATA code, city, and country.

Starting from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon, navigate to the "Giant-impact hypothesis" article by following a link on the Moon page (do not type its URL directly), then report approximately how long ago the giant impact is estimated to have occurred.
Open https://books.toscrape.com/, navigate to the "Travel" category by clicking its link, and report (a) how many results the category shows and (b) the title and price of the cheapest book in it.
Starting from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Photosynthesis, follow the link to the "Calvin cycle" article, and report the main product that stage of photosynthesis produces.
On https://books.toscrape.com/, navigate from the catalogue into a category, open a product, and report its price and availability.
